g.text: Odd-trial baseline | even-trial modulation | descriptive sign-constrained fits
One point = one neuron. Strips show cue-response composition; fitted curves are descriptive within one recording.
Axes use symmetric-log spacing with common limits covering every neuron; the plotted quantities retain their Hz units.
